records.text: After Charlie Kirk was shot, the camera operator ran a few yards to a grassy knoll, took out his phone, and began recording a selfie video.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: But this second close friend of Charlie chose to run just a few yards away—up to a grassy knoll— to take out his phone. A couple of seconds later, he takes out his phone, and he begins recording himself. It's a selfie video—takes a video of himself.

records.text: The camera operator was afraid that Google was going to hack him if he sent the footage behind Charlie Kirk's head over the internet.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: He said, after I offered, "You can just use WeTransfer," "I don't wanna just send the footage over the internet—that's behind Charlie's head—because I'm worried that Google might hack me."

records.text: The camera operator told Candace Owens he was on the phone with ops back in Arizona who were watching the event when Charlie Kirk was shot.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I also asked him who he was on the phone with after Charlie got shot. And he told me—and I kid you not— he was on the phone with the ops that were back in Arizona watching.

records.text: Candace Owens recorded her phone call with the camera operator who took down the cameras.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And I'm gonna speak more thoroughly about what it was that he said because, obviously, I recorded the phone call.
